create_hopper_env: create a Hopper mujoco environment with hopping mode enabled and default configuration
create_hopper_stand_env: create a Hopper mujoco environment in standing mode with custom config overrides
run_hopper_reset: run the Hopper environment reset method with a JAX random number generator array
run_hopper_step: run the Hopper environment step method with a state and action array
summarize_hopper_reward: summarize the Hopper hop and stand reward functions that compute standing and hopping metrics
